name: Gozen Reiji no Sanbika
source:
One day, the main character meets a girl in the underground mall. When they start dating, the girl becomes the abuser. Is a life of masochism what he desires?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角在地下商场遇见了一名女孩。当他们开始约会时，女孩成为施虐者。受虐狂的生活是他想要的吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
